title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Saturday, 17 October 2026
description: Waymo passes 100,000 paid robotaxi rides a week as Microsoft reports a major quantum error-correction breakthrough, more Australians than ever are moving from cities to regional areas, Queensland's bushfire season arrives early in the south east, and a $3 billion Gold Coast integrated resort moves into community consultation. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
